infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SHIELD needs your location to send it with SOS alerts.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: SHIELD uses background location to monitor safe zones and keep you protected even when the app is closed.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: SHIELD uses background location for geofencing and continuous safety monitoring.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow SHIELD to use your location for SOS alerts and safe zone monitoring.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow SHIELD to access your contacts to set emergency contacts.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow SHIELD to access your camera to capture evidence during SOS.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow SHIELD to save evidence photos to your gallery.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow SHIELD to use the microphone for voice trigger detection.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow SHIELD to use speech recognition to detect your voice trigger phrase.
